title: Can I CRUSH Dragon Bishop Chess? (Paradigm30)
summary: Paradigm30 chess (chess.com): bishops are upgraded to Dragon Bishops (bishop + knight, but the knight part 'can't jump') and the back-rank pieces are scrambled Chess960-style. Goal: three wins in a row vs ~2000 humans; achieved.
rules: Both sides' bishops are replaced by Dragon Bishops: move as a bishop or as a knight; the knight move cannot jump (blocked like a lame/'non-leaping' knight - a Paradigm30 rule; exact blocking square inferred as the orthogonal step).
Back-rank pieces are shuffled Chess960-style (same shuffle for both sides); castling allowed (he castles).
Pawns may promote to a Dragon Bishop (he chooses queen).
win_condition: Checkmate. Video goal: 3 wins in a row.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; zoomed inset of a dragon bishop in intro

custom_pieces.name: Dragon Bishop
custom_pieces.look: bishop with green dragon wings/claws (sprites XbCdL3oL_18_dragon_bishop*.png); redraw as winged bishop

setup: Chess960-style shuffled back rank with Dragon Bishops in place of bishops (exact shuffle varies per game).
current_impl_issues: Legacy fairy 'A' (archbishop that jumps) on normal setup - needs non-jumping knight component and 960 shuffle.
